reviewItem.question: For "Configuration `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` is removed: The setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` (`-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup`) was a…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The configuration setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` (CLI flag `-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup`) has been removed; environments that explicitly set it will have that setting ignored and the previous default value `false` applied.
